rows.en:
Run for it! Hoshim...
Wait, she's already gone!!
(Somehow I managed to get away, but...)
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders. Subject restored as 'I' (the player's own escape); 'we' would also fit.

rows.en:
How on earth did you get away?
The moment I took my eyes off you,
you were out of there before me...

Heh heh heh... That, I cannot tell you!
Anyway, good thing Hilda-sensei didn't
catch us. All's well!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders (old-fashioned oshierare masen na).

rows.en:
Seems we won't be playing in the pool
any more today. Shall we be off home, then?
Yeah, that seems like the best idea.
Well then, see ya laterrr~
(Phew, I'm glad Hilda-sensei didn't catch me~)

(But still, Hoshimura...
How did she get out of the pool and away
faster than me...? It's a mystery......)

(I snuck into the school pool with Yui
without permission again...)

Run for it! Yu...
Wait, she's already gone!!

How on earth did you get away?
The moment I took my eyes off you,
you were out of there before me...
Yeah, that seems like the best idea.

(But still, Yui...
How did she get out of the pool and away
faster than me...? It's a mystery......)

(I never thought I was this frail...
Who'd have thought I'd catch a cold
and end up in the hospital......)

(And after I'd promised Hoshimura
we'd go see a concert at the Sky Gate...)

Heyyy! You doin' all right~!?
\p!

Wait, you're in the hospital,
so of course you're not all right.

Hoshimura...
I'm glad you came to visit me, but
could you keep your voice down a bit...

Sorry, sorry. More to the point,
how fares your health?

Health-wise, I'm fine now.
They say I can leave the hospital soon.
Ooh! That's great to hear.

Oh, that's right, I brought you
a get-well gift. I'll go get it
ready real quick.

You really don't have to, Hoshimura.
Just coming to visit me is more than enough...

Don't sweat it!
Leave it to Yui-san, curry in a hurry~!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. Nonsense rhyme tag (makasenasai no Indo karee): rendered as a rhyme that keeps the curry.

rows.en:
(Not only did she come to visit me,
she even went and bought me a gift...
Thanks, Hoshimura.)

(I wonder if she got me some fruit,
like the usual get-well gift?)

Whew~ Sorry, sorry.
That took longer than I thought.
No, it's no proble......

Wait, hey!
What's with that outfit!? Hoshimura!!

Huh? Can't you tell just by looking?
This is......
A nurse's uniform!!
Why a nurse's uniform!?

I figured I'd nurse you, and everything
starts with looking the part, right? I even
bought a syringe! Aren't I a good girl?
Yeah... Good girl, good girl......
Aww, flattery won't get you anything~
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders; same as c14224.

rows.en:
(I was an idiot to expect
a normal gift from Hoshimura...)
Haaah... I think I'm getting a headache...

What!? Why, that's a grave matter!
The angel who descended to earth...
Leave it all to Nurse Yui, I say~!!

Okay, first we take your temperature.
Huh? I didn't bring a thermometer...
...All right! Bring your face over here!

I'll take your temperature with
the thermometer known as my forehead~!!
Come on! Bring it ooon!!

...Hoshimura, got a sec?
This is really hard to say, but......
Hm? What's the matter?
rows.notes: x4, Hoshimura, both genders; also nml_yui_019.

rows.en: Go change back right now!!

Tch, and I went to the trouble of buying it~
What about it didn't suit your fancy?

It's not a question of whether
it suits my fancy or not...

Well, I got to see you're well enough to shout,
so I guess I'll head home for today.

(Hoshimura came to visit me while I'm sick...
right? I can't help feeling she just
came to goof around...)
Oh, that's right!
Forget something?

If you ever wanna see me as a nurse, just say
the word! Byyye~!

(That's Hoshimura for you...
Everything she says and does is so out there,
I just can't compete...)

(I never thought I was this frail...
Who'd have thought I'd catch a cold
and end up in the hospital......)

(And after I'd promised Yui
we'd go see a concert at the Sky Gate...)

Yui...
I'm glad you came to visit me, but
could you keep your voice down a bit...

Health-wise, I'm fine now.
They told me I can leave the hospital soon.

You really don't have to, Yui.
Just coming to visit me is more than enough...

Don't sweat it!
Leave it to Yui-san, curry in a hurry~
rows.notes: Hoshimura, female scene; same gag as c14304.

rows.en:
(Not only did she come to visit me,
she even went and bought me a gift...
Thanks, Yui.)

(I wonder if she got me some fruit,
like the usual get-well gift?)

Wait!
What's with that outfit!? Yui!!

Huh? Can't you tell just by looking?
This is...
Yeah... Good girl, good girl......

(I was an idiot to expect
a normal gift from Yui...)

...Yui, have you got a moment?
This is really hard to say, but......
Go change back right now!!

It's not a question of whether
it suits my fancy or not...

(Yui came to visit me while I'm sick...
right? I can't help feeling she just
came to goof around...)
Forget something?

(That's Yui for you...
Everything she says and does is so out there,
I just can't compete...)

(I'm fully recovered now,
so today I'm going to enjoy a concert
at the Sky Gate with Hoshimura!)

Hey, \p!
You look perfectly healthy now.
Thanks to you.

Yup, it really is wonderful
that you're in tip-top shape, but...

You don't have any plans to go back
into the hospital, do you?

'Cause, y'know~
I went to all the trouble of buying a nurse outfit,
and I haven't had a single chance to wear it~!

C'mon, c'mon!
Go back in the hospital for me...
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders; cut off by the player.

rows.en: Maybe I'll head home now...
